purpose: Review-only claim ledger; not a new historical evidence matrix or a factual validator

claims.statement: The NASA report of 15 November 1963 lists 1963 3B with decay date 8 NOV 63
claims.locator: printed p. 8; PDF zero-based page 9; DECAYED OBJECTS
claims.note: The catalog is contemporaneous with the publication, but the terminal event itself was not observed by this review.

claims.statement: An FBIS text attributed to Radio Tupi Rio at 2330 8 NOV 63 W reported a metallic sphere, hole, body and inscriptions in Conde
claims.locator: FBIS 03, single page; typed header and body
claims.note: Tupi and its FBIS transcription are one report lineage, not two independent witnesses.

claims.statement: The 9 November TV Tupi Sao Paulo script was already reported as visually inspected, with no Conde mention
claims.locator: 24-page TV Sao Paulo script, prior matrix C111 and C117
claims.note: PR #8 cannot label C111/C117's established full inspection a new first pass.

claims.statement: PR 5 adds a coupled Cartesian r/v numerical kernel, J2 option, sourced-drag API, and seven synthetic tests
claims.note: Synthetic truth generated by the same model is not a blind historical validation.

claims.statement: A 198.5261 degree mirrored RAAN value conflicts with 284.1520 degrees in an earlier app dataset
claims.locator: Scientific audit: Serious conflict between historical orbit data sets
claims.note: No average or selected ground track is justified until original epochs, elements, frame and lineage are reconciled.

claims.statement: A derivative Blue Book case index lists the Conde case as Other (HOAX)
claims.locator: NOVEMBER 1963 case index, C232-C233; original case file not accessed
claims.note: Must not represent an index label as an empirical finding, and must not claim its page was visually checked.

claims.statement: Ownership links Tupi Rio and Diario de Noticias, but the exact transfer path of the Conde story is unverified
claims.note: A network relationship establishes a possible transmission mechanism, not proof of shared article text.
